concerns.text: Task T008 targets `mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1` (~47B params), violating FR-002 (1B MoE) and FR-007 (7GB RAM limit). The spec requires a 1B parameter MoE student; this task mandates a model physically impossible to load under the stated constraints, constituting a silent relaxation of the resource constraint.

Tasks T005.0 and T014.5 mandate fetching human labels from `HuggingFaceH4/aime_2024_human_labels` and raising `FileNotFoundError` if missing. The Spec (SC-006) and Plan require human-verified labels to avoid tautology, but neither document lists this specific dataset ID as a 'Verified Source'. This introduces a fatal dependency on an unverified external resource, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and risking pipeline failure.

Task T045 validates SC-002 against a Wikipedia URL (`https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Statistical_hypothesis_test`). Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) forbids using general encyclopedia links as authoritative references for scientific thresholds. This task weakens the verification standard required by the spec.

Tasks T019.5 and T032 mandate halting with a specific `RuntimeError` string on dimension mismatch. The Spec (Edge Cases) only requires reporting a 'specific architecture incompatibility error'. While the intent is similar, hard-coding a specific exception string in the task without spec authorization creates a rigid implementation constraint not present in the requirement, risking brittle code if the error message needs adjustment.

Task T005.1 duplicates T005.0 but adds 'or a specific local file path' as a fallback. The Spec (FR-009) and Plan explicitly state 'No synthetic data fallback' and require fetching from canonical sources. Allowing a local path fallback without a defined verification mechanism for that local file violates the 'Verified Accuracy' and 'Data Hygiene' principles by permitting unverified data sources.
